title: Drifter Bar Salts Pineapple Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Drifter Bar Salts Pineapple Ice is a tropical delight that brings together the exotic sweetness of pineapple with a refreshing icy finish. This e-liquid is an exhilarating combination that's both invigorating and soothing, perfect for vapers seeking a taste of the tropics but with a cool, menthol twist. From your first puff you’ll be transported to a sunny paradise with the vibrant, sweet flavour of pineapple. This authentic taste captures the essence of ripe, juicy pineapples, offering a burst of tropical sweetness. As you exhale, the coolness of ice envelops the pineapple notes, providing a crisp and refreshing finish that cleanses the palate and leaves you wanting more. Drifter's Bar Salts e-liquids are the perfect choice for starter vape kits and low-powered pod devices. Unlike regular freebase e-liquids, nicotine salts feature an alkaline formulation that allows for a higher concentration of nicotine while delivering a smoother throat hit than high-strength freebase liquids. Nicotine salt e-liquids provide near-instant relief from nicotine cravings because the nicotine is absorbed into the bloodstream faster. This makes them an ideal choice for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking immediate, satisfying nicotine relief. Drifter's Bar Salts and Bar Juice collections offer mouth-watering e-liquids inspired by the most popular flavours found in disposable vapes. They're just as intensely delicious and satisfying as disposable vape flavours, but with the added benefit of being compatible with your own reusable vape device. This saves you money and reduces waste in the process. Why not try other incredible flavours from Drifter's Bar Salts and Bar Juice collections? From sweet and refreshing Cotton Candy Ice to classics like Cherry and Blue Razz Lemonade, whatever your taste in e-liquid, Drifter E-liquid has an incredible flavour waiting to light up your tastebuds.
